- When sentiment is high (≥0.6) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; adjust forecast downward by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >5% from prior day), model often overshoots; cap forecast at 1–2% above peak for next 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment is low (≤0.2) and price is trending down, model underestimates; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.  
- Model consistently underestimates late-period (last 7–10 days) prices; apply 1–2% upward bias for final 5–7 days of forecast horizon.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating highs/lows (e.g., 0.6, 0.0, 0.6), model exhibits mean-reversion bias; smooth forecast by averaging last 3–5 values before final 3 days.
